scope: Existing Home services/treatment magnets and treatment stamp interaction
captureRange: A repeatable 50px gravity field on either side of centre, after real vertical scrolling settles. A 700ms accelerating glide starts gently and gains speed towards centre. Every qualifying stop can attract again. Clicks do not arm it; new input interrupts immediately, and notice bars move away for the correction.

stampLinks.optIn: data-tdb-stamp-link-mode=confirm on the native stamp section
stampLinks.behavior: An inactive or manually displaced stamp first selects and highlights only. Once the active image and strip have settled, a separate activation reveals the dark image overlay and existing arrow; the following activation opens the CMS link. Drag, wheel, main-slide change and Escape disarm. Touch does not rely on a compatibility click; modified clicks retain normal browser behavior.
stampLinks.nativeClasses: Reuses tdb-treatment-image-wrap, tdb-treatment-overlay, icon-embed-xxsmall and tdb-direct-arrow, with native overrides confined to the stamps variant. The original image and CMS link bindings remain intact.

magnet: Use the existing shared site motion policy; activate shared slider focus to move navbar, availability and VIP bars away. Exclude the correction from the user's scroll-away threshold. On screens where the full treatment assembly is taller than the viewport, centre the unchanged image frame.
stamps: Marquee-style velocity sampling and exponential coast (4.2/s, capped at 2800px/s), integrated analytically for consistent refresh-rate behavior. Mouse, tablet touch and phone touch share the same direct drag and release. Re-grab cancels momentum immediately. Existing finite bounds, first-tap selection and single-writer return alignment remain.

textHeightFollowUp.reason: User reported iPad text area resizing. Hidden titles inherited max-width:100% from narrow neighbouring image rows, changing their line counts during selection.
textHeightFollowUp.note: Medium already reserves 10rem. Small retains its existing 0px minimum and natural tallest-row space. Titles and copy remain in normal flow so future longer CMS copy can expand without clipping.

preserved: All image frame heights, spacing, card widths, lower-row clipping, image parallax, CTA and price alignment. Only text space is reserved per the follow-up request. No custom head CSS/JS or new embed.
